title: Wallapop dashboard (Datasette prototype — rejected, see ADR 0003)

everything.title: All listings
everything.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur, json_extract(specs,'$.compatible') AS compatible, json_extract(specs,'$.condition') AS condition FROM listing WHERE status='active'

by_target.title: By target
by_target.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur, json_extract(specs,'$.compatible') AS compatible FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND target = :target

title_search.title: Title search
title_search.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND lower(title) LIKE '%' || lower(:q) || '%'

compat_ok.title: Compatible
compat_ok.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND json_extract(specs,'$.compatible') = 1

compat_not.title: Not compatible
compat_not.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND json_extract(specs,'$.compatible') = 0

price_max.title: Price at most
price_max.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND price_eur <= CAST(:max_price AS REAL)

new_today.title: New today
new_today.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur, first_seen FROM listing WHERE status='active' AND date(first_seen) = date('now')

price_dropped.title: Price dropped
price_dropped.sql: SELECT target, title, url, price_eur FROM listing l WHERE status='active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation o WHERE o.listing_id = l.id AND o.price_eur > l.price_eur)
